title: Software Development Engineer
description: Developed a self-service marketing platform that helped AWS teams measure campaign impact, iterate faster, and create more precise customer communications. Improved the product's usability and extensibility while becoming the team's subject-matter expert for React and its internal CI/CD system.
highlights: Led major UI and UX refactoring efforts and served as the team's subject-matter expert for React and the internal CI/CD system, guiding implementation and delivery practices across the team.

Built and tested Java and TypeScript features using AWS CDK, React, and Cypress.
